final.answer: Yes. GV-12-3 is a solenoid valve and requires electrical power. It is available in 24 V DC and 230 V AC versions, so 24 V DC will work if that is the valve’s specified coil voltage; you do not necessarily need 230 V AC. Check the valve’s type plate to confirm its installed voltage.
